_comment: EVERY value in this file is read by code. Trimmed 2026-10-22 from 385 lines to this: the old file carried 7 whole sections (verification, demandSignal, statusRules, promotionAuthority, leedReadyDefinition, defaults, addLeedBusinessRequired) and ~20 sub-keys that NO code referenced. They read like they controlled promotion and controlled nothing -- tuning demandSignal.hotDaysOut or verification.* did literally nothing for months. If you add a key here, wire it in the same commit or do not add it. Full original kept at DOCS/SCORING.json.bak-2026-10-22.

_consumers.classification.orgNameTokens: classification.js isOrgName -- person vs org name test
_consumers.classification.futureMinHours: classification.js classify() -- how far out a date must be to count as future

classification._futureMinHours_note: Was absent from this file and silently defaulted to 12 in code (?? 12). Written out so the value is visible and tunable instead of hidden.
